positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: what is the calibration status of the Kestrelwood spectrograph, and on what basis is that status established?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the calibration result as settled fact; src-2 substantiates that same result by naming the verification method and reference standard used. Both expressions share the same speaker, the same technical register, and calm-positive/expert-authority readings — together they answer one question (is the instrument calibrated, and how do we know) rather than two separate ones. No tension to narrate: the two build directly on each other rather than opposing.
